name: Golden Carpets Limited
summary: Golden Carpets Limited specializes in the production and sale of floor coverings. The company employs sophisticated computerized electronic Jacquard technology for manufacturing, sourcing its heat-set polypropylene yarn from Turkey. Its extensive product line features both wall-to-wall carpeting and a variety of area rugs. Founded on December 2, 1993, the firm's main office is located in Hyderabad, India.
